tcw-1x15: Investigating slain clones on icy Orto Plutonia, Obi-Wan and Anakin discover the native Talz. Pantoran Chairman Cho pushes for war and is killed; Senator Chuchi makes peace.
tcw-1x17: Dr. Nuvo Vindi captures Padmé and Jar Jar in his secret Naboo lab, where he has revived a long-eradicated plague. The Jedi race to disarm his virus bombs.
tcw-1x18: When the Blue Shadow Virus escapes, infecting Ahsoka and Padmé, Anakin and Obi-Wan race to Iego for a cure, then must break the energy field trapping every visitor.
tcw-1x19: Leading her first squadron against Ryloth's blockade, Ahsoka defies Anakin's call to retreat and most of her pilots die. She must regain her nerve for a second strike.
tcw-1x20: Obi-Wan's clones must take out droid cannons in a Twi'lek town whose people are held as shields. Waxer and Boil befriend Numa, an orphan who knows the tunnels.
tcw-1x21: To free Ryloth's capital, Mace Windu needs rebel leader Cham Syndulla, who trusts the Republic little more than the droids. Their uneasy alliance storms Lessu, capturing Wat Tambor.
tcw-2x01: Benched to guard the Archives after a reckless fight, Ahsoka is on watch when Cad Bane and a shapeshifter break into the Temple and escape with a holocron.
tcw-2x02: Boarding Cad Bane's frigate, Anakin and Ahsoka arrive too late for Master Bolla Ropal, who dies under torture. Bane then threatens Ahsoka until Anakin unlocks the holocron.
tcw-2x03: Cad Bane uses the stolen holocron to abduct Force-sensitive children for Darth Sidious. The Jedi capture him, extract the children's location and mount a rescue on Mustafar.
tcw-2x17: Stranded on Felucia, Anakin, Obi-Wan and Ahsoka join Sugi's hired bounty hunters in training a farming village to stand against Hondo Ohnaka's pirates.
tcw-2x18: The Republic's new droid-killing bomb wins a battle on Malastare but awakens the Zillo Beast, a near-indestructible giant. Mace Windu argues to spare it; Palpatine wants it studied.
tcw-2x19: Brought to Coruscant, the Zillo Beast breaks loose when Palpatine orders it killed, hunts him across the city, and dies of poison. Palpatine quietly orders it cloned.
tcw-2x04: The Jedi ask Padmé to spy on Rush Clovis, an old flame with Separatist ties. A jealous Anakin shadows her as she exposes his plot on Cato Neimoidia.
tcw-2x05: The Republic returns to Geonosis to take down Poggle's droid factories. The landing turns into a bloodbath, and Anakin, Obi-Wan, Ahsoka and Ki-Adi-Mundi fight to break the shield.
tcw-2x06: While Anakin and Luminara draw off Poggle's super-tanks, Padawans Ahsoka and Barriss slip inside the droid foundry to destroy it, and are buried alive when it falls.
tcw-2x07: Chasing Poggle into an ancient temple, Luminara vanishes. Obi-Wan and Anakin follow her underground and face undead Geonosian warriors in thrall to a hidden queen.
tcw-2x08: Ferrying medical supplies, Ahsoka and Barriss discover Geonosian brain worms taking over their clone crew, then Barriss herself. Ahsoka must stop the parasites before they reach the front.
tcw-2x09: Grievous tortures captured Jedi Master Eeth Koth to taunt the Jedi. Obi-Wan, Anakin and Adi Gallia free Koth, but the cyborg general slips away again.
tcw-2x10: Wounded hunting Grievous on Saleucami, Rex shelters with Cut Lawquane, a clone who deserted to raise a family. After they fight off droids together, Rex keeps his secret.
tcw-2x11: When a pickpocket lifts Ahsoka's lightsaber on Coruscant, she hides the loss from Anakin and turns to Tera Sinube, an elderly Jedi who teaches her patience.
tcw-2x12: Investigating a Mandalorian attack, Obi-Wan rejoins his old friend Duchess Satine and learns the Death Watch rebels are led by a trusted governor, Pre Vizsla, backed by Dooku.
tcw-2x13: Escorting Duchess Satine to Coruscant, Obi-Wan and Anakin foil assassin droids and unmask a traitorous senator aboard her ship, while Anakin learns Obi-Wan once loved her.
tcw-2x14: The Senate votes to occupy Mandalore on doctored evidence. Blamed for a murder and hunted by Death Watch, Satine and Obi-Wan race to expose the truth.
tcw-2x20: Disguised as a clone cadet, young Boba Fett boards Mace Windu's cruiser to avenge his father. Aided by Aurra Sing, he sabotages the ship and it crashes.
tcw-2x21: Boba Fett and Aurra Sing lure Mace and Anakin into a booby-trapped wreck on Vanqor. With both Jedi pinned and hurt, R2-D2 must get word to the Temple.
tcw-2x22: After Aurra Sing executes Commander Ponds, Plo Koon and Ahsoka trail her and Boba Fett to Hondo's pirate base on Florrum, where the conflicted boy is finally caught.
tcw-2x15: When Onaconda Farr, a senator Padmé loves like an uncle, is poisoned at a gathering of colleagues, she finds the killer is his own aide, Lolo Purs.
tcw-3x05: Visiting war-starved Mandalore, Padmé helps Duchess Satine trace poisoned tea sickening the capital's children to smugglers feeding a black market that corrupt officials protect.
tcw-3x06: Teaching at Mandalore's academy, Ahsoka helps Satine's nephew Korkie and his classmates prove that Prime Minister Almec runs the black market, even as he moves to silence them.
tcw-3x07: Haunted by visions of Aurra Sing, whom she believes dead, Ahsoka joins Padmé at a refugee summit on Alderaan and must trust the Force to stop an assassination.
tcw-3x02: Ventress and Grievous strike Kamino from the sea to wipe out clone production. Rex, Cody, Echo and Fives hold the line, but the fight costs 99 his life.
tcw-3x04: When his daughters are kidnapped to force Pantora into the Separatists' arms, Chairman Papanoida hunts Greedo on Tatooine while Ahsoka and Senator Chuchi search the Trade Federation blockade.
tcw-3x08: Sent shopping for Padmé's banquet, C-3PO and R2-D2 are snatched by Cad Bane, who pulls the Senate building's plans from R2 and then wipes their memories.
tcw-1x22: Cad Bane seizes senators as hostages to force Ziro the Hutt's release, unaware that Anakin is loose in the building without his lightsaber. Palpatine ultimately frees Ziro.
tcw-3x09: Freed from Hutt captivity by his old flame Sy Snootles, Ziro hunts for his diary of Hutt crimes. Obi-Wan and Quinlan Vos give chase, but Sy kills him.
tcw-3x10: Padmé secretly travels to Raxus with Ahsoka to seek peace with her mentor Mina Bonteri. Ahsoka meets the Separatists as people, while profiteers plot to wreck the talks.
tcw-3x11: Padmé, Bail and Onaconda Farr fight a bill to deregulate the banks and buy more clones. Hired thugs beat Bail and stalk Padmé, whose speech still sinks it.
tcw-3x12: Ordered by Sidious to be rid of his too-powerful apprentice, Dooku betrays Asajj Ventress. She survives, returns to the Nightsisters of Dathomir and strikes back at her master.
tcw-3x13: Ventress picks Savage Opress from the Nightbrothers through deadly trials, and Talzin's magic makes him a monster. Given to Dooku as an apprentice, he secretly serves the witches.
tcw-3x14: Obi-Wan and Anakin trace a Jedi-killer to Dathomir as Savage Opress and Ventress turn on Dooku. When the plot collapses, Talzin sends Savage to find his long-lost brother.
tcw-3x15: An ancient Jedi signal pulls Obi-Wan, Anakin and Ahsoka to Mortis, where the godlike Father tests whether Anakin is the Chosen One, able to master his warring children.
tcw-3x16: The Son seizes Ahsoka and corrupts her to lure Anakin. His dagger thrust at the Father strikes the Daughter instead, and she spends her last strength reviving Ahsoka.
tcw-3x17: Shown his future as Darth Vader, Anakin sides with the Son to avert it. The Father wipes the vision and dies so Anakin can slay the Son.
tcw-3x18: Smuggled in carbonite, Obi-Wan, Anakin, a clone team and a stowaway Ahsoka break into the Citadel, a prison built for Jedi, to free Even Piell and Captain Tarkin.
tcw-3x19: Breaking out of the Citadel with the freed prisoners, the Jedi argue tactics as Tarkin sows doubt. Their shuttle is blown apart, and Echo is lost.
tcw-3x20: Stranded on Lola Sayu, the Jedi march the freed prisoners toward Plo Koon's rescue fleet. Mauled by hunting beasts, Even Piell dies, passing his secret to Ahsoka.
tcw-3x21: Captured on Felucia, Ahsoka wakes on a Trandoshan hunting moon alongside abducted younglings. She rallies them to fight back, but the struggle claims Kalifa's life.
tcw-3x22: New captive Chewbacca helps Ahsoka and the younglings rig a transmitter on the Trandoshan hunting moon. It summons Tarfful's Wookiee warriors, who help them overthrow the hunters.
fod-1x11: Struggling to handle two lightsabers, Ahsoka is challenged to a duel by Yoda, who teaches her that the style that makes her unique is also her strength.
fod-2x02: Ahsoka is assigned to a mission Anakin hoped to spend alone with Padmé. His impatient shortcut drops all three into a Separatist blockade they must escape together.
fod-1x06: Before a delicate negotiation, Ahsoka notices a table set wrong in Padmé's apartment and exposes the handmaiden as Cato Parasitti, a shape-shifting assassin with a hidden bomb.
fod-1x12: During a flying lesson, a lurking droid fighter ambushes Ahsoka and Padmé. When Ahsoka is knocked out shielding her friend, Padmé must improvise to win alone.
fod-1x04: Hurrying to a Temple ceremony, Ahsoka stops to save an Aleena mother and child from a haywire droid. Yoda rewards her with a longer Padawan braid.
tcw-4x01: Mon Cala's king is murdered and the Quarren revolt. As Padmé's peace talks fail, Riff Tamson's Separatist army strikes, and untested Prince Lee-Char must survive to lead.
tcw-4x02: With the Republic force routed beneath Mon Cala's seas, Ahsoka guards Prince Lee-Char as the Gungan army arrives to help. Tamson's whirlpools sweep the allies into captivity.
tcw-4x03: Captured by Riff Tamson, the Jedi endure interrogation as Prince Lee-Char and Ahsoka rally the prisoners. The Quarren switch sides, and Lee-Char slays Tamson and is crowned.
tcw-4x04: Jar Jar, a dead ringer for the wounded Boss Lyonie, poses as the Gungan leader and helps capture Grievous, until Dooku seizes Anakin and forces a prisoner swap.
tcw-4x05: After quakes batter the planet Aleen, R2-D2 and C-3PO tumble into a strange realm beneath the surface and learn only droids can seal the breach behind the tremors.
tcw-4x06: Escaping Grievous aboard a Y-wing, C-3PO and R2-D2 wander from world to world, meeting tiny Patitites and the people of Balnab before landing in a pirate gladiator pit.
tcw-4x07: When Anakin is recalled from the Umbara campaign, Jedi General Pong Krell takes the 501st. His ruthless orders cost Rex's men dearly in the push toward the capital.
tcw-4x08: Pong Krell sends Rex's men up a narrow gorge to take an Umbaran airbase, brushing off every objection. Casualties mount before the clones improvise their way to victory.
tcw-4x09: Defying Krell's orders, Fives, Jesse and Hardcase steal Umbaran starfighters to destroy an enemy supply ship. Hardcase gives his life, and Krell orders the survivors court-martialed.
tcw-4x10: Krell orders Fives and Jesse shot, then tricks two clone battalions into firing on each other. Rex's men realize their general is a traitor, and Dogma ends him.
tcw-4x11: Arriving to defend the Togruta colony on Kiros, Anakin, Obi-Wan and Ahsoka find it empty. Dooku has sold the colonists to Zygerrian slavers, who leave bombs behind.
tcw-4x12: Posing as a slaver on Zygerria to find the missing Togruta, Anakin is ordered to whip Obi-Wan. Their escape fails, and Queen Miraj keeps Anakin as her slave.
tcw-4x13: Anakin warns Queen Miraj she is Dooku's pawn, and Dooku kills her. On Kadavo, Obi-Wan nears despair in a slave camp until Anakin and Ahsoka free the colonists.
tcw-4x14: Lux Bonteri storms a peace summit to accuse Dooku of his mother's murder, then seeks revenge through Death Watch. Ahsoka follows and witnesses his new allies' brutality.
tcw-4x15: Obi-Wan fakes his death and wears his assassin's face to infiltrate a plot against Palpatine from a cell beside Cad Bane. Anakin, kept in the dark, grieves.
tcw-4x16: Fleeing with Cad Bane and Moralo Eval, the disguised Obi-Wan keeps his cover while Anakin, blind to the ruse, hunts the man he thinks killed his master.
tcw-4x17: Still disguised, Obi-Wan competes with Cad Bane in Dooku's lethal trial on Serenno, the Box, where only five bounty hunters win places in the kidnapping plot.
tcw-4x18: At Naboo's Festival of Light, Dooku's hired hunters, with Obi-Wan still undercover among them, move to seize Palpatine. Anakin, now in on the secret, races to stop them.
tcw-4x19: Dooku sends Grievous to destroy the Nightsisters for their betrayal. Ventress and Mother Talzin lead the witches' defense of Dathomir, but the droid army wipes out their clan.
tote-01: Young Morgan Elsbeth survives Grievous's massacre of the Nightsisters and shelters with the peaceful Mountain Clan, until her thirst for revenge endangers their young and leaves her alone.
tcw-4x20: Adrift, Ventress joins Boba Fett's bounty hunters guarding a chest on Quarzite. The cargo is an unwilling bride, so Ventress swaps in a bound Boba and frees her.
tcw-4x21: Savage Opress tracks his long-lost brother to the junk world of Lotho Minor and finds Maul alive, half-mad and scuttling on spider-like legs.
tcw-4x22: Restored by Mother Talzin, Maul massacres a village to lure Obi-Wan into a trap. Facing both brothers, Obi-Wan survives by teaming up with Ventress, who wants Savage's bounty.
tcw-5x02: The Jedi secretly train rebels on Separatist-held Onderon, among them Lux Bonteri and siblings Steela and Saw Gerrera, to retake their capital from a puppet king.
tcw-5x03: The Onderon rebels strike across Iziz but struggle to win over the people. Steela Gerrera is chosen to lead over her brother Saw, and only Ahsoka stays behind.
tcw-5x04: The rebels try to stop King Dendup's execution and are caught. General Tandin turns on the puppet king to free them, and Ahsoka breaks her orders to help.
tcw-5x05: Onderon's people rise against the droids, and Hondo's rockets help the rebels fight back. Victory restores King Dendup, but Steela falls to her death when Ahsoka's Force grip breaks.
tcw-5x06: Ahsoka takes six younglings to Ilum's ice caves, where each must overcome a personal flaw to claim a lightsaber crystal before the entrance freezes over.
tcw-5x07: Heading home from Ilum, the younglings are building their lightsabers with the droid Huyang when Hondo's pirates board to steal their crystals. Ahsoka is captured holding them off.
tcw-5x08: With Ahsoka held for sale on Florrum, the younglings sneak into Hondo's base disguised as acrobats in a traveling troupe and free her.
tcw-5x09: Grievous storms Hondo's Florrum stronghold, forcing Ahsoka and the captured younglings into an alliance with the pirates to repel the droids and escape.
tcw-5x10: Colonel Gascon, a strategist with no field experience, leads R2-D2 and a droid squad aboard a Separatist dreadnought to steal a decoding module, and learns to trust them.
tcw-5x11: Downed by a comet storm, D-Squad crash-lands on Abafar, a featureless desert. As power and tempers run low, the droids and Colonel Gascon must cross the Void together.
tcw-5x12: Stranded in a dusty Abafar town, D-Squad finds Gregor, an amnesiac clone commando washing dishes. As his training returns, he stays behind to cover their escape.
tcw-5x13: D-Squad's ride home is a droid-hijacked cruiser packed with explosives, aimed at a Republic summit. M5-BZ and R2-D2 sacrifice themselves to stop it, though R2 is later rebuilt.
tcw-5x01: Maul and Savage Opress plunder the Outer Rim and seize Hondo's pirates to build a following. Obi-Wan and Adi Gallia track them down, and Savage kills Adi.
tcw-5x14: Rescued adrift by Death Watch, Maul and Savage ally with Pre Vizsla and force Black Sun, the Pykes and the Hutts into a criminal army aimed at Mandalore.
tcw-5x15: Maul's criminals stage chaos in Sundari so Death Watch can play saviors and topple Satine. Betrayed by Pre Vizsla, Maul kills him in a duel and takes Mandalore.
tcw-5x16: Obi-Wan slips onto Mandalore alone to rescue Satine, but Maul captures him and kills her before his eyes. Darth Sidious arrives to punish his former apprentice, killing Savage.
tcw-5x17: A bomb rips through the Jedi Temple, and Anakin and Ahsoka trace it to Letta Turmond, who turned her husband into a walking weapon with nano-droids.
tcw-5x18: Summoned by bomber Letta Turmond, Ahsoka finds her strangled by someone using the Force. Framed for the murder and clashing with Admiral Tarkin, she breaks out of custody.
tcw-5x19: In Coruscant's underworld, Ahsoka teams up with an unlikely ally, Asajj Ventress, as Anakin hunts her. A friend's tip leads her to hidden explosives, and into a trap.
tcw-5x20: Expelled by the Jedi and tried for murder, Ahsoka is saved when Anakin unmasks the real bomber, her friend Barriss Offee. Invited back, Ahsoka walks away.
tcw-6x01: At Ringo Vinda, trooper Tup kills a Jedi Master and can't explain why. Escorting him to Kamino, Anakin and Fives fend off a Separatist bid to seize him.
tcw-6x02: Quarantined on Kamino, Fives and droid AZI-3 dig into why Tup killed a Jedi and find a strange growth in his brain. Removing it costs Tup his life.
tcw-6x03: Facing a memory wipe, Fives escapes the Kaminoans and, with AZI-3, finds the same organic chip in every clone's brain. He has his own cut out.
tcw-6x04: Taking his findings to Palpatine, Fives is framed for attacking the Chancellor and hunted across Coruscant. He reaches Rex and Anakin just before Commander Fox shoots him.
tcw-6x05: Seeking a loan on Scipio, Padmé learns from Rush Clovis that the Banking Clan's leaders are looting it. With Anakin's help, they flee the bounty hunter Embo.
tcw-6x06: Clovis exposes the Banking Clan's corrupt leaders and is installed to run it, secretly thanks to Dooku. Anakin's jealousy of Clovis pushes his marriage to the brink.
tcw-6x07: Clovis's deal with Dooku comes due as droids occupy Scipio. The Republic invades; Clovis falls to his death to spare Padmé, and Palpatine gains control of the banks.
tcw-6x08: When Bardotta's Force-attuned mystics start vanishing, Queen Julia will trust only Jar Jar. Mace Windu comes along, and the pair uncover a cult that abducts the queen.
tcw-6x09: Mace and Jar Jar chase the kidnapped Queen Julia to Zardossa Stix, where a cult drains the Force from its victims. Its hidden leader is Mother Talzin.
tcw-6x10: Sifo-Dyas's long-lost lightsaber sends Obi-Wan and Anakin digging into his death and the clone army's origins. The trail runs through the Pykes to Dooku himself.
tcw-6x11: Yoda hears the voice of long-dead Qui-Gon Jinn. With the Council fearing the dark side at work, he slips away from the Temple to follow it to Dagobah.
tcw-6x12: Guided by Qui-Gon, Yoda reaches the planet at the Force's source, where five Priestesses test him, first by making him face his own dark side.
tcw-6x13: On Moraband, the Sith homeworld, Yoda faces a final test as Darth Sidious tries to snare him in a vision. Yoda holds firm, earning the path beyond death.
tcw-L1: Investigating a Jedi Master's death on Utapau, Obi-Wan and Anakin uncover a black-market deal to sell the Separatists a weapon of frightening power.
tcw-L2: Tracking the arms dealers across Utapau, Obi-Wan and Anakin let themselves be captured to reach their prize, a giant kyber crystal. Anakin also vents about Ahsoka's departure.
tcw-L3: Obi-Wan and Anakin haul a giant kyber crystal across Utapau with Grievous on their heels, until a treacherous governor hands it to the Separatists.
tcw-L4: Aboard Grievous's warship with the kyber crystal, Obi-Wan and Anakin turn its power on the droids, then overload it, wrecking the ship and much of the Separatist fleet.
tcw-7x05: Newly on her own, Ahsoka crashes into Coruscant's underworld and befriends the pilot Trace Martez. She must keep her Jedi skills quiet when a rogue droid runs amok.
tcw-7x06: Rafa books a smuggling run on Trace's new ship. Learning the cargo is Pyke spice, Trace dumps it, leaving the sisters and Ahsoka owing a deadly syndicate.
tcw-7x07: Held by the Pykes on Oba Diah, Ahsoka and the bickering Martez sisters attempt a breakout but are shot down and recaptured, as hidden Mandalorians watch Ahsoka.
tcw-7x08: Ahsoka stays as the Pykes' hostage while the Martez sisters fetch replacement spice, and discovers the syndicate answers to Maul. Then Bo-Katan asks her help against him.
tcw-7x01: Facing droids that predict his every tactic on Anaxes, Rex joins Clone Force 99, a squad of mutant clones, and finds signs that Echo may be alive.
tcw-7x02: Anakin, Rex and Clone Force 99 raid a Techno Union fortress on Skako Minor and find Echo alive, wired into machines that turn his mind against the Republic.
tcw-7x03: Freed but frail, Echo escapes Wat Tambor's fortress with Anakin, Rex and Clone Force 99 on tamed keeradaks, then helps defend the local Poletec village from Tambor's droids.
tcw-7x04: With Echo's knowledge, Anakin, Rex and Clone Force 99 infiltrate Admiral Trench's dreadnought to feed the droids false plans. Anakin ends Trench, and Echo joins his new squad.
tcw-7x09: Ahsoka and Bo-Katan seek the Republic's help to free Mandalore from Maul. Called away to Coruscant, Anakin returns Ahsoka's lightsabers and lends her Rex's troops.
tcw-7x10: Maul warns Ahsoka that Sidious is poised to seize the galaxy, with Anakin as his prize. Refusing to join him, she duels Maul across Sundari and captures him.
tcw-7x11: Taking the captured Maul to Coruscant, Ahsoka is aboard a cruiser full of clones when Order 66 comes. Rex, fighting his programming, warns her just in time.
tbb-1x01: Order 66 fails to sway most of Clone Force 99, and the Empire turns on them. They flee Kamino with young Omega as a reprogrammed Crosshair stays behind.
tcw-7x12: Hunted aboard a cruiser of clones obeying Order 66, Rex and Ahsoka fight their way out as Maul wrecks the ship. They bury the fallen and disappear.
tote-04: Imprisoned as the Jedi fall, Barriss Offee accepts an offer to join the Inquisitors. Trained by the Grand Inquisitor, she earns her place by killing a rival recruit.
totj-06: After Padmé's funeral, Ahsoka hides among farmers under a false name. When an Inquisitor burns their village, she kills him and calls Bail Organa, ready to fight again.
tbb-1x02: Hunter hopes to leave Omega with deserter Cut Lawquane's family on Saleucami. When the Empire's new chain codes force the Lawquanes to flee, Omega chooses the squad instead.
tbb-1x03: Stranded on a barren moon, Omega helps Hunter track a power-eating dragon that stole a vital part. Elsewhere, Crosshair leads the Empire's new enlisted squad against Saw Gerrera.
tbb-1x04: A supply stop on Pantora goes wrong when bounty hunter Fennec Shand comes for Omega, chasing her and Hunter across the moon's city streets.
tbb-1x05: To learn who hired the bounty hunter chasing Omega, the squad takes a job from Ord Mantell fixer Cid: rescue a young rancor, Muchi, from Zygerrian slavers.
tbb-1x06: Sent to steal a tactical droid's head from a Corellian scrapping plant, the squad clashes with Rafa and Trace Martez, thieves quietly working for an anti-Imperial movement.
tbb-1x07: Rex tracks down the Batch and leads them to a derelict Jedi cruiser to remove their inhibitor chips, but Wrecker's chip activates first, turning him against Omega.
tbb-1x08: Still aboard a derelict cruiser on Bracca, the Batch are cornered by Crosshair and his troopers. They fight their way out, only for Cad Bane to snatch Omega.
tbb-1x09: Cad Bane delivers Omega to a Kaminoan handoff on Bora Vio as the Batch learn she is an unaltered Jango Fett clone. Fennec Shand's ambush lets her escape.
tbb-1x10: Hired to spring former Separatist senator Avi Singh from Imperial arrest on Raxus, the Batch find their old enemy is now standing up to the Empire.
tbb-1x11: Hera Syndulla is swept into Ryloth's resistance to the Empire. Her parents rescue her from an Imperial convoy, but Rampart has Crosshair wound Senator Taa and blames them.
tbb-1x12: Young Hera Syndulla enlists Hunter's squad to free her parents from Imperial custody in Lessu, and clone Captain Howzer must choose between orders and conscience.
tbb-1x13: When a gangster, Roland Durand, seizes Cid's parlor as a front for Pyke spice, the Batch and Cid steal his shipment through bug-infested tunnels to break his deal.
tbb-1x14: Rex sends the squad to rescue his friend Gregor from a hidden Imperial base on Daro, where non-clone recruits are training. Hunter is captured covering their escape.
tbb-1x15: Crosshair lures his old squad to Kamino using the captured Hunter. Abandoned by the Empire, he reveals his chip is long gone, and Imperial ships bombard Tipoca City.
tbb-1x16: As Tipoca City sinks, the Batch and Omega struggle to escape with the unconscious Crosshair. He helps save AZI-3 but still refuses to leave with them.
tbb-2x01: Cid offers the Batch a job that could clear their debts: stealing Count Dooku's war chest from Imperial-held Serenno. The heist goes wrong and splits the squad.
tbb-2x02: Stranded on Serenno with Tech hurt, Omega and Echo shelter with Romar, a survivor of the Imperial bombing, until Omega sneaks off after the war chest.
tbb-2x03: Crosshair and Commander Cody move against a Separatist holdout on Desix. When Crosshair executes its surrendered governor on Imperial orders, Cody questions their choices and deserts.
tbb-2x04: When Cid loses a bet on Safa Toma, crime boss Millegi holds her as collateral. Omega bargains for one more race, and Tech drives to win her back.
tbb-2x05: Omega's junkyard relic leads the Batch and treasure hunter Phee Genoa to an uncharted world, where the fabled vault turns out to be an ancient war machine.
tbb-2x06: Omega frees Gungi, a young Wookiee Jedi held by smugglers, and the Batch take him home to Kashyyyk, where Trandoshans with Imperial tanks are burning Wookiee villages.
tbb-2x07: Riyo Chuchi finds a clone who can expose the truth about Kamino's destruction, but an assassin silences him. Rex rescues Chuchi; the killer dies rather than talk.
tbb-2x08: The Batch help Rex steal proof of Rampart's attack on Kamino, and Chuchi exposes him. Palpatine turns the scandal into a law replacing clones; Echo leaves with Rex.
totu-01: Revived by Mother Talzin at a steep price, Ventress hides as a spaceport guard until a Jedi boy, Lyco Strata, draws her into a fight with an Inquisitor.
totu-02: Ventress and Lyco help Latts Razzi rob an Imperial shipyard in return for the Hidden Path's location. Razzi betrays them to sell Lyco; Ventress turns the tables.
totu-03: Seeking the Hidden Path, Ventress and Lyco end a Separatist veteran's water war with local raiders. Then Lyco passes up his escape to stay with Ventress.
tbb-2x09: A thief steals the Marauder while the Batch mine volatile ipsium for Cid on a stormy world. Trapped by a cave-in and missing Echo, Omega and Tech reconcile.
tbb-2x10: Tracking Gonky's signal, the Batch catch Baro, the young thief who took their ship, and make him guide them to Mokko, a boss who cheats his own miners.
tbb-2x11: Probing a crashed Imperial science ship, the Batch discover a cloned Zillo Beast. As commandos reclaim it, Tech concludes Kamino was razed so the Empire could seize cloning.
tbb-2x12: Posted to an icy depot on Barton IV, Crosshair bonds with veteran clone Mayday. When Lieutenant Nolan lets Mayday die, Crosshair kills Nolan and wakes in a lab.
tbb-2x13: Phee Genoa brings the Batch to Pabu, a hidden island sanctuary for refugees. When a tsunami hits, the clones help evacuate its people and stay on to rebuild.
tbb-2x14: Echo and Gregor free dissident clones from a transport bound for Dr. Hemlock's science division, and the Batch learn Crosshair is Hemlock's prisoner, sending them a coded warning.
tbb-2x15: The Batch sneak into Tarkin's summit on Eriadu to track Hemlock, whose base holds Crosshair, and run into Saw Gerrera's plot to bomb it. Their escape stalls midair.
tbb-2x16: Tech gives his life so the Batch can escape Eriadu. Then Cid sells them out to Hemlock, who carries Omega off to his lab, where Crosshair is held.
tbb-3x01: A prisoner on Wayland, Omega works in Hemlock's lab beside her clone sister, Emerie Karr, and befriends a lurca hound, Batcher, whom she sets free.
tbb-3x02: Following a lead to Setron, Hunter and Wrecker find Hemlock's old lab bombed flat and three abandoned clone cadets surviving among engineered killer vines.
tbb-3x03: As the Emperor tours Tantiss, Omega seizes her chance, frees Crosshair and escapes with him and Batcher. Hemlock learns her blood holds the key to his secret project.
tbb-3x04: Crash-landed on Lau, Omega and Crosshair must outwit a corrupt Imperial captain to get off-world with Batcher. Omega then reunites with Hunter and Wrecker, Crosshair in tow.
